# Versioned presentation examples

Both examples render the same deterministic doctor model. They demonstrate the presentation contract, not the current host's health.

## Human

```text
Camp doctor: blocked
BLOCKED  pasta  pasta_missing  pasta is unavailable
  remediation: install passt outside Camp, then rerun camp doctor
```

## JSON

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "kind": "doctor",
  "status": "blocked",
  "results": [
    {
      "capability": "pasta",
      "status": "blocked",
      "code": "pasta_missing",
      "summary": "pasta is unavailable",
      "remediation": "install passt outside Camp, then rerun camp doctor"
    }
  ]
}
```
